title: Ultimate Create Modpack
description: This is my version of a Create Mod Pack!
body:
![Create Mod](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/055df4e8d9608df03bfec42ebbca04899688e4f5.png)
## **⚙️ Industrial Innovation**
Harness the power of rotational force, with Create and some addons like Create: Steam n Rails, Create: Enchantment Industry, and Create: Deco, and much more, you can build massive automated factories, train networks, and cool mechanical contraptions.

## **🌍 An Immersive World**
The world feels more alive than ever.

- **AmbientSounds & Sound Physics Remastered:** Experience a rich, directional audio environment where caves echo and forests hum.

- **BetterThirdPerson & Camera Overhaul:** Enjoy a more fluid, modern movement feel.

- **Visual Enhancements:** With Oculus and Embeddium support, enjoy stunning shaders and high-fidelity graphics without the typical performance hit.

## **🛠️ Quality of Life & Performance**
No more lag or clunky interfaces.

- **Performance:** mods like Embeddium, FerriteCore, and Starlight, and some others, provide higher framerate for your Minecraft gameplay.

- **Utility:** Features like JEI (Just Enough Items), Mouse Tweaks, and Inventory Essentials make managing your resources effortless.

- **Cross-Platform Tech:** Includes Sinytra Connector, allowing **_most_** mods from fabric to be played on Forge.
